title: Figure-Eight Layup Combo
description: Players dribble a tight figure-eight pattern at the top of the key, then attack the rim, linking ball-handling control directly to finishing.

content.objective: Transfer a tight, controlled dribble pattern directly into a decisive drive to the rim.
content.setup: Players start at the top of the key with a ball, facing the basket.
instructions: Dribble a tight figure-eight between and around the legs for five full cycles.
On the sixth cycle, explode forward into a drive toward the basket.
Finish with a layup using two hard dribbles to get there.
Jog back and switch the hand that leads the figure-eight.
coachingPoints: Keep the figure-eight tight and low before exploding forward.
Attack in a straight line once the move starts — no hesitation.
Finish strong with the correct footwork at the rim.
commonMistakes: Losing control of the figure-eight before the drive even starts.
Drifting sideways instead of attacking downhill.
Watching the ball instead of keeping the head up.
content.safety: Make sure the path to the rim is clear before exploding forward.
